selection: Unmodified copies of LICENCE and the binary32 FP8 outputs of H100 and H200 (model_validation/{H100,H200}/{E4M3,E5M2}/d_*_fp32.txt) as published in releases v0.1 and v0.2. Their inputs (a, b, c) are the files of commit 79143bd, vendored in ../matlab-tensor-core-79143bd: commits between v0.2 and v0.3 replaced only these output files. Not included: everything else.
purpose: These are the only recorded H100 and H200 FP8 outputs in which c is accumulated (the 79143bd outputs of the same inputs agree with a zero accumulator). scripts/check_device_replay.py replays them through the FP8 mma.sync model (two interleaved FP16 block FMAs, then c in binary32), which they match bit for bit; it is the recorded evidence for that model on Hopper.
